description: Portland, this is your sign to take a staycation. ✨ I spent the weekend with PDX Staycation, a perfect night at the Woodlark hotel, dinner at Bullard Tavern, an espresso martini at Abigail Hall, and wine + a bubble bath to end the night. 🥂🛁 No flight required. Just enjoy your city differently. #PDXStaycation #PortlandOregon #ThingsToDoInPortland #PDX
